purpose: Download, align, coordinate-audit, and deterministically freeze up to 64 PPARA structures for cognate redocking without reading docking or protected-panel outcomes.

reference.pocket_derivation: wild-type chain-A standard amino-acid residues with a heavy atom within 6.0 A of any 735 heavy atom
reference.anchor_derivation: the reference-pocket subset with a heavy atom within 4.0 A of any 735 heavy atom

coordinate_gate.chain_identifier: author chain from the frozen Stage47b candidate metadata
coordinate_gate.alternate_location_rule: highest occupancy, then blank, A, and lexical tie-break
coordinate_gate.alignment: proper-rotation Kabsch alignment using same-number, same-residue-name protein C-alpha atoms
coordinate_gate.global_incomplete_residue_policy: record only during structural selection; apply one frozen deterministic completion protocol before receptor preparation and redocking

features: pairwise ligand-pocket side-chain heavy-atom centroid distances
structural_pool.standardization: feature-wise z score over all coordinate-eligible structures, then division by the square root of retained feature count
structural_pool.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance seeded by PPARA_2P54_reference; ties resolved by lexical conformer ID
structural_pool.failure_action: stop before receptor preparation, redocking, production docking, QUBO fitting, protected validation access, or hardware if fewer than 32 structures pass

interpretation_boundary: Passing Stage49b establishes only a label-independent, coordinate-qualified PPARA receptor pool. Receptor preparation and frozen three-seed cognate redocking remain mandatory before production docking. No enrichment, QUBO superiority, cross-family generalization, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage conclusion follows.
